thread:
Maya: FYI I hit a really confusing exception while following the Python quickstart sample app. The async client returns a bare RuntimeError instead of a structured HTTP error with status/request_id.
Sam: Reproduced on my machine. Server returns 422/400 but SDK raises 'RuntimeError: request failed' and there's no programmatic access to the response fields.
Maya: Tiny repro snippet I used:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
await client.responses.create(input=None)  # deliberately invalid payload
```
Sam: Stack I see:
```
RuntimeError: request failed
  File "/.../redwood/client/async_client.py", line 198, in _call
response body: {"error": "invalid_input", "request_id": "r-xxx"}
```
Julia: That matches a bug I remember — the sync client constructs redwood.errors.RequestError(status=..., raw_body=...) but the async path wraps into a generic RuntimeError and loses parsed JSON.
Maya: This hits onboarding hard. Folks can't correlate the SDK error with server logs without request_id.
Sam: Proposed plan:
- create HTTPValidationError(Exception) subclass for 4xx with attributes: status (int), raw_body (str), parsed (strified JSON), request_id (str)
- ensure AsyncClient re-raises that class and attaches the parsed payload
- add typing stubs so users can do: except redwood.errors.HTTPValidationError as e and access e.request_id in typed code
Julia: Also add py.typed and update errors/__init__.py exports. Will add unit tests for exception shape and mypy checks.
Maya: Test idea: add a tiny e2e in sampleapp CI that makes an invalid request, asserts one of the exceptions is HTTPValidationError and e.request_id equals header returned by test server.
Sam: I opened https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/4629 with repro + logs and started a draft PR (github.com/redwood/repo/pull/812).
ci-bot: CI for PR 812 started: job test-async-exceptions (running) :gear:
Maya: Can we escalate to P1? This is blocking quickstarts and sampleapp onboarding.
Julia: +1 from me. I'll prioritize the type annotations and include a migration note for callers who might be catching RuntimeError.
Sam: I'll add a small changelog entry and a compatibility note in the SDK release notes.
Maya: Thanks — ping here once CI passes so we can roll the sampleapp image. :thumbsup:
